title: Lakeside Heffley Hideaway

services.name: Campsite L1
services.desc: Our cabins are situated in a very private cove, and every cabin is either very close to, or right on, the lake. The campground is located a short walking distance from the cabin area, and each campsite has a beautiful view of the lake. Our prime sites are located lakeside.We can accommodate anything from a tent to a large RV with power and water access (please note, no sani-dump!). Our nearby central washroom facilities have flush toilets, running water and hot water coin-op

services.name: Water activity rentals
services.desc: For safety and liability reasons, we require all members of your party to participate in the water activity rental. This helps us ensure everyone is accounted for as we don’t have day-use space. If someone in your party has their own water activity, they will need to launch at the public boat launch by the Heffley Recreational site and you can meet up on the lake. Please note dogs are not permitted with activity rentals. Just check in with the store to fill out a waiver, pay for your activity and put down a deposit.
